title: An escalation email template that an SLA uses can be deleted with no warning
label: BUG
date: TAVI 10 Nov 2026 (live, on screen) · Zoho: help article (live Zoho did not load on this network)
env: TAVI staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging, owner) · template "QA AO SL57h156 escalation template" chosen in SLA "QA AO SL57h156 (inactive)", QA AO Dept A · Zoho: help.zoho.com › Managing email templates › Deleting Email Templates

panels.caption: Before: the SLA’s level 1 sends "QA AO SL57h156 escalation template" (1).
Email Templates › Delete: the dialog only says it can’t be undone. No mention that an SLA uses it (2).
After: the SLA shows "A template that no longer exists"; the default email is used instead. The admin only finds out by opening this target (3).
Zoho Desk help, Deleting Email Templates: lists the delete steps and that public templates cannot be deleted (2). What Zoho does for a template an SLA uses is not documented and was not seen live.

rows: Template chosen in an SLA escalation level
A custom escalation template can be chosen per level.
The admin is told the template is used by an SLA (TAVI already refuses to delete business hours an SLA uses).
Deleted after a generic "can’t be undone" confirmation; no mention of the SLA. Zoho’s behaviour for in-use templates is not documented.
The SLA keeps a valid template, or the admin picks a new one at delete time.
The SLA still points at the deleted template; escalations silently fall back to the default email. Shown only inside the target editor.
